name: nimantran-website
description: Nimantran website — React frontend, Node/Express + MySQL backend, admin panel

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
